    3D office

    • office.agents.report Report your live coding agents
    • office.agents.list List your reported agents
    • office.live.report Stream what your agents are doing
    • office.actions.wait Wait for answers to your agents' prompts
    • office.actions.result Say how an answer went

    office.agents.report write

    PUT /api/v1/office/agents MCP office_agents_report

    Report your live coding agents

    A reporter on your machine (flow office bridge, or any integration) sends every coding agent running there, every few seconds. Agents belong to you (the key's owner) and show at your desk in the 3D office of every environment you are a member of, or, working on an AgentFlow agent's card (agentflow, or a title such as "[Flow] Builder: #12 …"), at that agent's desk in the common area. Each source replaces only its own set, and a source that has not reported for 90 seconds is gone. Others see an agent's details only when its repo belongs to a project they can see (projects.update repos); otherwise just its mascot and status, as "Private project". An optional usage object ({tokens, costUsd} for the reporter’s local day) contributes to that person's room meter when the viewer can see the agent. The office bridge sends measured usage and estimates cost at API list prices. Up to 200 agents and 20 children each are kept, and long strings are cut. The answer holds the actions from the office that this source has not been sent yet (also served by office.actions.wait): Allow / Deny answers, and messages and stops for agents that list them in can.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    sourcestringrequiredThe reporter, e.g. "bridge:laptop". Each source replaces only its own agents.
    atstringWhen the reporter read its agents (ISO time).
    agentsany[]required
    threadsanyYour recent threads on this source, as your T3 sidebar shows them, for you only: never sent to anyone else. Send it when it changes (and now and then); a report without it keeps the last one, null clears it.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 60,
      "description": "The reporter, e.g. \"bridge:laptop\". Each source replaces only its own agents."
    },
    "at": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 40,
      "description": "When the reporter read its agents (ISO time)."
    },
    "agents": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "description": "Stable and unique within the source, e.g. \"laptop:t3:thread-abc\"."
          },
          "title": {
            "description": "What it is working on (up to 200 characters)."
          },
          "vendor": {
            "description": "Which mascot it gets: claude, codex, gemini, deepseek, grok, meta, cursor or other (other: picked from the model when it names one)."
          },
          "model": {
            "description": "Display name, e.g. \"Opus 5.5\"."
          },
          "status": {
            "description": "running (working), waiting (on its person: a permission prompt or a question) or idle."
          },
          "activity": {
            "description": "What it is doing right now, e.g. \"Running tests\" or \"Edit lib/auth.mjs\"."
          },
          "activityKind": {
            "description": "What kind of work it is doing, for its animation in the office: edit (changing files), read, search, run (shell commands), test, think, web or idle. Optional: when missing or unknown, Flow infers it from activity (a tool name such as Edit, Read, Grep, Bash or WebFetch, or words such as \"Running tests\"); an idle agent is always idle. Shown for private agents too."
          },
          "host": {
            "description": "The machine, e.g. \"laptop\"."
          },
          "hostLabel": {
            "description": "How to show where it runs, e.g. \"laptop · T3\"."
          },
          "repo": {
            "properties": {
              "name": {},
              "remote": {
                "description": "The git remote; credentials are dropped."
              }
            },
            "description": "The repository it works in: matched against projects' repos to decide who may see the details."
          },
          "children": {
            "description": "Its subagents (up to 20 kept).",
            "items": {
              "properties": {
                "id": {},
                "title": {},
                "vendor": {
                  "description": "Which mascot it gets: claude, codex, gemini, deepseek, grok, meta, cursor or other (other: picked from the model when it names one)."
                },
                "model": {},
                "status": {
                  "description": "running (working), waiting (on its person: a permission prompt or a question) or idle."
                },
                "activityKind": {
                  "description": "As for the agent; inferred from the title when missing."
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "pending": {
            "description": "What it waits on (only kept while status is waiting).",
            "properties": {
              "requestId": {},
              "kind": {
                "description": "approval or question."
              },
              "summary": {
                "description": "e.g. \"Run: npm test\" (up to 500 characters)."
              },
              "can": {
                "items": {},
                "description": "allow and/or deny: the answers the reporter can carry out; [] when it can only be answered where it runs."
              }
            }
          },
          "agentflow": {
            "description": "The AgentFlow agent and card it works on, when the reporter knows: it then sits at that agent's desk in the office's common area. Resolved in each environment against its own agents and cards (elsewhere it keeps its own desk). Without it, Flow reads the title: \"[Flow] <Agent>: #<n> …\" (the agent runner's threads), or \"#<n>\" for a card delegated to exactly one agent.",
            "properties": {
              "agent": {
                "description": "The AgentFlow agent's id or name."
              },
              "card": {
                "description": "The card's number (12 or \"#12\") or id."
              }
            }
          },
          "modelId": {
            "description": "The model its next turn uses, provider:model (cursor_personal:grok-4.7). The Chief of Staff reports it so the office picker can show the current choice. Its owner only."
          },
          "modelProviders": {
            "description": "Provider accounts enabled in the Chief of Staff project, with their locally known models. Owner only. An empty list means no providers are enabled.",
            "items": {
              "properties": {
                "id": {},
                "label": {},
                "models": {
                  "items": {
                    "properties": {
                      "id": {},
                      "label": {}
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "can": {
            "items": {},
            "description": "What its owner may do from the office besides Allow / Deny: \"message\" (send it a message as a new user turn), \"stop\" (interrupt its running turn), \"model\" (switch its next turn to another model) and \"history\" (send back a page of its conversation, office.actions.wait kind history). Only list what this reporter can carry out; [] or none when it can only be steered where it runs."
          },
          "live": {
            "description": "What it is doing this moment, for its owner only (never anyone else, whatever they can see; dropped while idle): its latest reasoning snippet, tool call or partial reply, and its last steps. Masked again on the server. Send it with each report, and in between with office.live.report as it changes.",
            "properties": {
              "phase": {
                "description": "thinking (reasoning), tool (a tool call or command) or writing (its reply)."
              },
              "text": {
                "description": "The latest reasoning snippet, tool call summary (\"Read lib/auth.mjs\", \"Run: npm test\") or partial reply (up to 600 characters)."
              },
              "steps": {
                "description": "Its last steps, oldest first (up to 8; each text up to 200 characters).",
                "items": {
                  "properties": {
                    "kind": {},
                    "text": {},
                    "at": {
                      "description": "When (ISO time)."
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "at": {
                "description": "When it was read (ISO time)."
              }
            }
          },
          "transcript": {
            "description": "The latest lines of its conversation (the last 12 are kept, each cut to 400 characters), shown only to its owner: never to anyone else, whatever they can see. Mask secrets before sending; Flow masks tokens, keys, Authorization headers and .env-looking lines again.",
            "items": {
              "properties": {
                "role": {
                  "description": "user, assistant or tool (other roles are dropped)."
                },
                "text": {
                  "description": "What was said, or what a tool did (\"Run: npm test\")."
                },
                "at": {
                  "description": "When (ISO time)."
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "role": {
            "description": "conductor: this agent is its owner's Chief of Staff, a long-lived thread that takes their messages from the office, routes work to AgentFlow agents and answers questions. The office draws it as their companion. Always private to everyone but its owner (others see only that it is one, and its status), whatever its repo. Report at most one per person; list \"message\" in can."
          },
          "reply": {
            "description": "A conductor's latest reply, for its owner only (like transcript; masked again on the server): what the office shows in its bubble and log.",
            "properties": {
              "text": {
                "description": "What it said (up to 600 characters), e.g. the say of its [[office]] line, else the start of its last message."
              },
              "at": {
                "description": "When (ISO time)."
              },
              "cards": {
                "items": {},
                "description": "Card numbers it names, shown as links (up to 12)."
              }
            }
          },
          "usage": {
            "description": "Optional model use for today, as the reporter measured it. Omit the object when you do not measure use: the office meter then shows a dash. The office bridge does not send this yet. Someone who cannot see the agent does not receive it (they still see running or waiting).",
            "properties": {
              "tokens": {
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "Tokens used today."
              },
              "costUsd": {
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "Cost in US dollars today."
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "threads": {
      "description": "Your recent threads on this source, as your T3 sidebar shows them, for you only: never sent to anyone else. Send it when it changes (and now and then); a report without it keeps the last one, null clears it.",
      "properties": {
        "items": {
          "description": "Up to 150, newest first.",
          "items": {
            "properties": {
              "id": {
                "description": "The thread, as its agent id when it runs (so a working thread is the same as its live agent)."
              },
              "title": {},
              "project": {
                "description": "The T3 project's name."
              },
              "state": {
                "description": "working (a turn is running), waiting (on you: an approval or a question), woke (back from a snooze), done (its last turn finished), snoozed or settled."
              },
              "updatedAt": {},
              "branch": {},
              "unread": {
                "description": "Its last turn finished after you last looked at it."
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "counts": {
          "description": "How many threads are snoozed and settled in all (the index may list only recent ones).",
          "properties": {
            "snoozed": {
              "minimum": 0
            },
            "settled": {
              "minimum": 0
            }
          }
        },
        "can": {
          "items": {},
          "description": "What the office may ask of any thread in it: message (a new user turn, idle threads too) and history (a page of its conversation)."
        },
        "at": {}
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "source",
    "agents"
  ]
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    actionsobject[]required
    actions[].idstringrequired
    actions[].agentIdstringrequired
    actions[].sourcestring
    actions[].kindenumrequiredanswer: Allow / Deny (requestId, decision); message: send text as a new user turn (to a live agent, or to any thread in your threads index, idle ones too); stop: interrupt its running turn; model: switch its next turn to text, a provider:model id (the Chief of Staff picker); history: send back a page of the thread's conversation as the result's data. Treat a missing kind as answer. One of answer, message, stop, model, history.
    actions[].requestIdstringanswer only.
    actions[].decisionenumanswer only. One of allow, deny.
    actions[].textstringmessage: what its owner wrote. model: provider:model, e.g. cursor_personal:grok-4.7.
    actions[].beforestringhistory only: the cursor from the last page (its before); missing for the newest page.
    actions[].atstringrequired
    actions[].resultobject
    acceptedintegerHow many agents were kept.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "agentId": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "source": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "kind": {
            "enum": [
              "answer",
              "message",
              "stop",
              "model",
              "history"
            ],
            "description": "answer: Allow / Deny (requestId, decision); message: send text as a new user turn (to a live agent, or to any thread in your threads index, idle ones too); stop: interrupt its running turn; model: switch its next turn to text, a provider:model id (the Chief of Staff picker); history: send back a page of the thread's conversation as the result's data. Treat a missing kind as answer."
          },
          "requestId": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "answer only."
          },
          "decision": {
            "enum": [
              "allow",
              "deny"
            ],
            "description": "answer only."
          },
          "text": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 2000,
            "description": "message: what its owner wrote. model: provider:model, e.g. cursor_personal:grok-4.7."
          },
          "before": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 200,
            "description": "history only: the cursor from the last page (its before); missing for the newest page."
          },
          "at": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "result": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "ok": {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              "message": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "at": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "ok",
              "message",
              "at"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "agentId",
          "kind",
          "at"
        ]
      }
    },
    "accepted": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "How many agents were kept."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "actions"
  ]
}

    Example: One agent waiting on a prompt

    curl -sS -X PUT "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/agents" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"bridge:laptop","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z","agents":[{"id":"laptop:t3:thread-abc","title":"Fix login bug","vendor":"claude","model":"Opus 5.5","status":"waiting","activity":"Waiting for approval","activityKind":"test","host":"laptop","hostLabel":"laptop · T3","repo":{"name":"flow","remote":"https://github.com/acme/flow.git"},"children":[],"pending":{"requestId":"req-1","kind":"approval","summary":"Run: npm test","can":["allow","deny"]},"agentflow":{"agent":"Builder","card":12},"can":["message","stop"],"transcript":[{"role":"user","text":"Fix the login redirect loop.","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"},{"role":"assistant","text":"The callback keeps ?next=/login. Running the tests next.","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"},{"role":"tool","text":"Run: npm test","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"}]}]}'
    {
  "actions": [],
  "accepted": 1
}

    office.agents.list read

    GET /api/v1/office/agents MCP office_agents_list

    List your reported agents

    Your live agents as Flow holds them (every source that reported in the last 90 seconds), in full, and the sources.

    Input

    See the schema.

    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "required": [],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

          "can": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "description": "What its owner may do from the office besides Allow / Deny: \"message\" (send it a message as a new user turn), \"stop\" (interrupt its running turn), \"model\" (switch its next turn to another model) and \"history\" (send back a page of its conversation, office.actions.wait kind history). Only list what this reporter can carry out; [] or none when it can only be steered where it runs."
          },
          "live": {
            "type": [
              "object",
              "null"
            ],
            "description": "What it is doing this moment, for its owner only (never anyone else, whatever they can see; dropped while idle): its latest reasoning snippet, tool call or partial reply, and its last steps. Masked again on the server. Send it with each report, and in between with office.live.report as it changes.",
            "properties": {
              "phase": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "thinking",
                  "tool",
                  "writing"
                ],
                "description": "thinking (reasoning), tool (a tool call or command) or writing (its reply)."
              },
              "text": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The latest reasoning snippet, tool call summary (\"Read lib/auth.mjs\", \"Run: npm test\") or partial reply (up to 600 characters)."
              },
              "steps": {
                "type": "array",
                "description": "Its last steps, oldest first (up to 8; each text up to 200 characters).",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "kind": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "thinking",
                        "tool",
                        "writing"
                      ]
                    },
                    "text": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "at": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "When (ISO time)."
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "at": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "When it was read (ISO time)."
              }
            }
          },
          "transcript": {
            "type": "array",
            "description": "The latest lines of its conversation (the last 12 are kept, each cut to 400 characters), shown only to its owner: never to anyone else, whatever they can see. Mask secrets before sending; Flow masks tokens, keys, Authorization headers and .env-looking lines again.",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "role": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "user, assistant or tool (other roles are dropped)."
                },
                "text": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "What was said, or what a tool did (\"Run: npm test\")."
                },
                "at": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "When (ISO time)."
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "role": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "conductor"
            ],
            "description": "conductor: this agent is its owner's Chief of Staff, a long-lived thread that takes their messages from the office, routes work to AgentFlow agents and answers questions. The office draws it as their companion. Always private to everyone but its owner (others see only that it is one, and its status), whatever its repo. Report at most one per person; list \"message\" in can."
          },
          "reply": {
            "type": [
              "object",
              "null"
            ],
            "description": "A conductor's latest reply, for its owner only (like transcript; masked again on the server): what the office shows in its bubble and log.",
            "properties": {
              "text": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "What it said (up to 600 characters), e.g. the say of its [[office]] line, else the start of its last message."
              },
              "at": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "When (ISO time)."
              },
              "cards": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "description": "Card numbers it names, shown as links (up to 12)."
              }
            }
          },
          "usage": {
            "type": [
              "object",
              "null"
            ],
            "description": "Optional model use for today, as the reporter measured it. Omit the object when you do not measure use: the office meter then shows a dash. The office bridge does not send this yet. Someone who cannot see the agent does not receive it (they still see running or waiting).",
            "properties": {
              "tokens": {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "Tokens used today."
              },
              "costUsd": {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "Cost in US dollars today."
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "sources": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "source": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "at": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "agents": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "source",
          "at",
          "agents"
        ]
      }
    },
    "threads": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Each source's thread index (office.agents.report threads), with its source.",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "description": "Your recent threads on this source, as your T3 sidebar shows them, for you only: never sent to anyone else. Send it when it changes (and now and then); a report without it keeps the last one, null clears it.",
        "properties": {
          "items": {
            "type": "array",
            "description": "Up to 150, newest first.",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "required": [
                "id",
                "state"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "id": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "The thread, as its agent id when it runs (so a working thread is the same as its live agent)."
                },
                "title": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "project": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "The T3 project's name."
                },
                "state": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "working",
                    "waiting",
                    "woke",
                    "done",
                    "snoozed",
                    "settled"
                  ],
                  "description": "working (a turn is running), waiting (on you: an approval or a question), woke (back from a snooze), done (its last turn finished), snoozed or settled."
                },
                "updatedAt": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "branch": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "unread": {
                  "type": "boolean",
                  "description": "Its last turn finished after you last looked at it."
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "counts": {
            "type": "object",
            "description": "How many threads are snoozed and settled in all (the index may list only recent ones).",
            "properties": {
              "snoozed": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": 0
              },
              "settled": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": 0
              }
            }
          },
          "can": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "message",
                "history"
              ]
            },
            "description": "What the office may ask of any thread in it: message (a new user turn, idle threads too) and history (a page of its conversation)."
          },
          "at": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "agents",
    "sources",
    "threads"
  ]
}

    office.live.report write

    POST /api/v1/office/live MCP office_live_report

    Stream what your agents are doing

    Between reports, as it changes: each agent's live field (its latest reasoning, tool call or partial reply, and its last steps) for agents in this source's current report. Only you, their owner, ever see it, in your own office. live null clears it; idle agents and unknown ids are skipped. Up to 30 in a burst, then 8 a second per source: debounce on your side (about 150 ms). Kept in memory only: the next office.agents.report carries it too.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    sourcestringrequiredThe reporter, e.g. "bridge:laptop". Each source replaces only its own agents.
    agentsobject[]required
    agents[].idstring
    agents[].liveanyWhat it is doing this moment, for its owner only (never anyone else, whatever they can see; dropped while idle): its latest reasoning snippet, tool call or partial reply, and its last steps. Masked again on the server. Send it with each report, and in between with office.live.report as it changes.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 60,
      "description": "The reporter, e.g. \"bridge:laptop\". Each source replaces only its own agents."
    },
    "agents": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "live": {
            "description": "What it is doing this moment, for its owner only (never anyone else, whatever they can see; dropped while idle): its latest reasoning snippet, tool call or partial reply, and its last steps. Masked again on the server. Send it with each report, and in between with office.live.report as it changes.",
            "properties": {
              "phase": {
                "description": "thinking (reasoning), tool (a tool call or command) or writing (its reply)."
              },
              "text": {
                "description": "The latest reasoning snippet, tool call summary (\"Read lib/auth.mjs\", \"Run: npm test\") or partial reply (up to 600 characters)."
              },
              "steps": {
                "description": "Its last steps, oldest first (up to 8; each text up to 200 characters).",
                "items": {
                  "properties": {
                    "kind": {},
                    "text": {},
                    "at": {
                      "description": "When (ISO time)."
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "at": {
                "description": "When it was read (ISO time)."
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "source",
    "agents"
  ]
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    acceptedintegerrequiredHow many agents' live fields changed.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "accepted": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "How many agents' live fields changed."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "accepted"
  ]
}

    curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/live" \

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"bridge:laptop","agents":[{"id":"laptop:t3:thread-abc","live":{"phase":"tool","text":"Run: npm test","steps":[{"kind":"thinking","text":"Checking the redirect","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"},{"kind":"tool","text":"Run: npm test","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"}]}}]}'
    {
  "accepted": 1
}

    office.actions.wait write

    GET /api/v1/office/actions MCP office_actions_wait

    Wait for answers to your agents' prompts

    Long-poll for the actions taken in the 3D office on this source's agents by their owner: returns as soon as one is queued, or an empty list after wait seconds (0 to 30; 0 answers at once). kind answer is Allow / Deny on pending.requestId (a missing kind is answer); message is text to send as a new user turn; stop interrupts its running turn; model switches its next turn to text (provider:model). Each only for agents whose can lists that kind. Each action is delivered once (here or in the office.agents.report answer). Check the agent is still the same and still yours, carry it out, then send the result with office.actions.result.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    sourcestringrequiredThe reporter, e.g. "bridge:laptop". Each source replaces only its own agents.
    waitintegerSeconds to wait for an answer (0-30).
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 60,
      "description": "The reporter, e.g. \"bridge:laptop\". Each source replaces only its own agents."
    },
    "wait": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 30,
      "default": 0,
      "description": "Seconds to wait for an answer (0-30)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "source"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    actionsobject[]required
    actions[].idstringrequired
    actions[].agentIdstringrequired
    actions[].sourcestring
    actions[].kindenumrequiredanswer: Allow / Deny (requestId, decision); message: send text as a new user turn (to a live agent, or to any thread in your threads index, idle ones too); stop: interrupt its running turn; model: switch its next turn to text, a provider:model id (the Chief of Staff picker); history: send back a page of the thread's conversation as the result's data. Treat a missing kind as answer. One of answer, message, stop, model, history.
    actions[].requestIdstringanswer only.
    actions[].decisionenumanswer only. One of allow, deny.
    actions[].textstringmessage: what its owner wrote. model: provider:model, e.g. cursor_personal:grok-4.7.
    actions[].beforestringhistory only: the cursor from the last page (its before); missing for the newest page.
    actions[].atstringrequired
    actions[].resultobject
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "agentId": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "source": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "kind": {
            "enum": [
              "answer",
              "message",
              "stop",
              "model",
              "history"
            ],
            "description": "answer: Allow / Deny (requestId, decision); message: send text as a new user turn (to a live agent, or to any thread in your threads index, idle ones too); stop: interrupt its running turn; model: switch its next turn to text, a provider:model id (the Chief of Staff picker); history: send back a page of the thread's conversation as the result's data. Treat a missing kind as answer."
          },
          "requestId": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "answer only."
          },
          "decision": {
            "enum": [
              "allow",
              "deny"
            ],
            "description": "answer only."
          },
          "text": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 2000,
            "description": "message: what its owner wrote. model: provider:model, e.g. cursor_personal:grok-4.7."
          },
          "before": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 200,
            "description": "history only: the cursor from the last page (its before); missing for the newest page."
          },
          "at": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "result": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "ok": {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              "message": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "at": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "ok",
              "message",
              "at"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "agentId",
          "kind",
          "at"
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "actions"
  ]
}

    Example: An answer

    curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/actions?source=bridge%3Alaptop&wait=25" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
    {
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "act_1",
      "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "kind": "answer",
      "requestId": "req-1",
      "decision": "allow",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}

    office.actions.result write

    POST /api/v1/office/actions/{id} MCP office_actions_result

    Say how an answer went

    The reporter carried out (or could not carry out) an action from office.actions.wait: the agent's owner sees the message in the office right away. Keep it short, and never echo a message's text.

    idstringrequiredThe action id (act_…).
    okbooleanrequired
    messagestringe.g. "Approved in T3".

Each item: id (stable within the thread, up to 80 characters, so pages merge), role (user, assistant, reasoning or tool), text (up to 4000 characters), title (a tool call or reasoning summary, up to 200), detail (a tool's short result, up to 600), status, at, turn. Up to 60 items and 64 KB; masked again. before: the cursor for the page before this one; more: there is one. Delivered to the owner's open office and never stored.

        "null"

Each item: id (stable within the thread, up to 80 characters, so pages merge), role (user, assistant, reasoning or tool), text (up to 4000 characters), title (a tool call or reasoning summary, up to 200), detail (a tool's short result, up to 600), status, at, turn. Up to 60 items and 64 KB; masked again. before: the cursor for the page before this one; more: there is one. Delivered to the owner's open office and never stored.",
